purpose: Teach: 隣り/変っ/ぶらぶら/思い立っ/すかさず/たどり着く/不意/あからさま

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お隣りの叔母さんがお見えになるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your aunt next door is coming by.
lines.style: Gentle, practical announcement. Warm tone, speaking to a child she trusts will understand. Light cadence, no urgency—just a heads-up for his day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんのご様子、変ってないよね?
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa's doing okay, right? Nothing's changed?
lines.style: Quiet worry underneath. Careful phrasing—he's checking, not asking for reassurance he doesn't believe. Small, serious voice. Waiting for the answer.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと公園をぶらぶらしてらしたわね
lines.en: You and Dad were wandering around the park earlier, weren't you?
lines.style: Observational, gently curious. Not questioning—confirming what she already knows. Warm, watching-over tone. Like she's been keeping an eye on his day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、急に思い立って、絵を描きたくなったよ
lines.en: Mom, I suddenly felt like drawing. Can I?
lines.style: Bright spark of idea breaking through. Direct, simple want. Small voice but certain. The honesty of a child naming what he needs in the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママはすかさずおやつを用意したわよ
lines.en: So I got your snacks ready right away, of course.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact satisfaction. Quick, efficient—this is what she does. Warm undertone: she knew before he asked. Practical care wrapped in simplicity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお家にたどり着くのに時間かかったよ
lines.en: Mom, it took me a while to get to Grandpa's house.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. He's reporting something he's noticed about himself—that the journey took longer than expected. Quiet, considering tone. Not complaining, just observing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、不意の雨でお父さん、慌てたわね
lines.en: That sudden rain really caught your dad off guard.
lines.style: Light, wry amusement beneath the surface. Not mocking—gently noticing how transparent his father was. Warm, knowing tone. A small smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんのお気持ち、あからさまに顔に出てたよ
lines.en: Yeah, Dad's feelings were all over his face.
lines.style: Small, knowing laugh in the voice. He's noticed the same thing mom noticed—how unguarded his father was. Dry, gentle observation. The perceptiveness of a quiet child catching what adults usually miss.
